footer.tagline: Convenient, transparent car rental. Book online in minutes, no account required.

hero.body: Pick your dates, choose your car, and drive off in minutes. No account required, and the price you see is the price you pay.

howItWorks.step1Body: Pick a city near you from dozens of pick-up points across the country.
howItWorks.step2Body: Tell us when you need the car and for how long. We'll hold it for you.
howItWorks.step3Body: Confirm your details and you're set. Your ride will be ready and waiting.
howItWorks.title: Renting a car with us takes three simple steps, from picking a location to driving away.

about.title: Car rental, without the runaround
about.intro: BestCar connects renters with a vetted fleet of vehicles in every country we serve. We built the platform we wished existed: clear pricing, a fast booking flow, and no pressure to create an account before you can even see a total.
about.v1Body: The price you see on a car's page is the price you pay. No hidden fees added at checkout.
about.v2Body: Pick your dates, confirm your details, and you're done. No account required to get started.
about.v3Body: Every vehicle listed is inspected and insured before it goes live on the platform.
about.readyBody: Browse the fleet and book the right car for your trip today.

consent.title: Cookies and your privacy
consent.body: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language. With your permission we also use analytics to see how the site is used. You can change your mind at any time.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.intro: See what we keep about you, take a copy, change your cookie choice, or delete your account.
privacy.downloadBody: A file with your account, bookings, licence details, messages, reviews and preferences.
privacy.cookiesBody: Necessary cookies are always on. Analytics run only if you allow them.
privacy.deleteBody: This removes your personal data and anonymises your bookings. Payment and booking records that we must keep by law stay, without your name, email or phone. You cannot delete while a booking is open or a dispute is unresolved. This cannot be undone.
